items.title: Condensing boiler plant
items.text: The building is served by a central condensing boiler plant. Boilers appeared operational at the time of the walkthrough and no immediate reliability issues were reported by operations staff.

items.title: Heating distribution observations
items.text: Heating is distributed through the building hydronic loop and associated terminal units. Distribution pumps and associated piping were observed in generally serviceable condition during the site visit.

items.title: Heating controls via BAS
items.text: Heating plant operation is integrated with the BAS for scheduling and control. Additional trend review and optimization may provide further operating improvements.
